_comment: The ACCEPTED identity of the packages under test, recorded once here so
the support-bundle tool can state the Git commit without scraping the
binary. Binary scraping is unreliable and was deliberately not attempted.
This file is data, not a claim: Make-SupportBundle.ps1 VERIFIES the
executable SHA-256 against it and says plainly in the bundle whether the
running binary matched. A mismatch is reported, never hidden.
limitation: FIELD TEST - NOT FOR OFFICIAL COMPETITION RESULTS
